products.name: Cognigy
products.note: Conversational AI platform for customer service; GDPR-compliant; EU-hosted options

profile_text.body:
Cognigy is a software company that provides an AI-powered customer service platform aimed at enterprise contact centers. The company describes itself as offering generative and conversational AI agents designed to deliver fast, personalized service, and it positions its product for deployment in contact center environments.

The company's core platform, also referred to as Cognigy, falls within the enterprise AI and agent orchestration category. It is described as a conversational AI platform built for customer service, with GDPR compliance and EU-hosted deployment options available for organizations with data residency requirements.

No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are reflected in the held facts for Cognigy.
